simple.meaning: מָבוֹא (mâbôwʼ) is a Hebrew object word meaning “an entrance (the place or the act); specifically sunset or the west ; also (adverb with preposition) towards.” BibleIQ follows the concrete thing through the verses where it appears.
simple.biblicalBackground: The occurrence trail begins at Deuteronomy 11:30. The surrounding context includes kingship, city, land, wilderness.
simple.inThisVerse: In this verse, the tapped English word is source-aligned to מָבוֹא (H3996) in the Hebrew text.
simple.whyItMatters: Concrete words often carry patterns through Scripture because objects, animals, offerings, and created things are used repeatedly in worship, judgment, covenant, and narrative.
simple.summary: מָבוֹא (mâbôwʼ) / H3996 is traced through Deuteronomy 11:30, Joshua 1:4, Joshua 23:4, Judges 1:24 with generated occurrence evidence.

timeline.evidenceText: Aren’t they beyond the Jordan, behind the way of the going down of the sun, in the land of the Canaanites who dwell in the Arabah near Gilgal, beside the oaks of Moreh?
From the wilderness and this Lebanon even to the great river, the river Euphrates, all the land of the Hittites, and to the great sea toward the going down of the sun, shall be your border.

Behold, I have allotted to you these nations that remain, to be an inheritance for your tribes, from the Jordan, with all the nations that I have cut off, even to the great sea toward the going down of the sun.
The watchers saw a man come out of the city, and they said to him, “Please show us the entrance into the city, and we will deal kindly with you.”
He showed them the entrance into the city, and they struck the city with the edge of the sword; but they let the man and all his family go.
So they made way for her; and she went by the way of the horses’ entry to the king’s house, and she was slain there.
He removed the covered way for the Sabbath that they had built in the house, and the king’s entry outside to Yahweh’s house, because of the king of Assyria.
They went to the entrance of Gedor, even to the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.

Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, of his father’s house, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the thresholds of the tent. Their fathers had been over Yahweh’s camp, keepers of the entry.

Then she looked, and, behold, the king stood by his pillar at the entrance, and the captains and the trumpets by the king. All the people of the land rejoiced, and blew trumpets. The singers also played musical instruments, and led the singing of praise. Then Athaliah tore her clothes, and said, “Treason! treason!”
So they made way for her. She went to the entrance of the horse gate to the king’s house; and they killed her there.
The Mighty One, God, Yahweh, speaks,
He appointed the moon for seasons.
From the rising of the sun to its going down,
Beside the gates, at the entry of the city,
Then Zedekiah the king sent and took Jeremiah the prophet to himself into the third entry that is in Yahweh’s house. Then the king said to Jeremiah, “I will ask you something. Hide nothing from me.”

By reason of the abundance of his horses, their dust will cover you. Your walls will shake at the noise of the horsemen, of the wagons, and of the chariots, when he enters into your gates, as men enter into a city which is broken open.

They come to you as the people come, and they sit before you as my people, and they hear your words, but don’t do them; for with their mouth they show much love, but their heart goes after their gain.
From under these rooms was the entry on the east side, as one goes into them from the outer court.

Yahweh said to me, “Son of man, mark well, and see with your eyes, and hear with your ears all that I tell you concerning all the ordinances of Yahweh’s house, and all its laws; and mark well the entrance of the house, with every exit of the sanctuary.

definitions.short: an entrance (the place or the act); specifically sunset or the west ; also (adverb with preposition) towards
definitions.usage: by which came, as cometh, in coming, as men enter into, entering, entrance into, entry, where goeth, going down, westward. Compare 4126 .
definitions.full: H3996. mabo מָבוֺא noun masculine Jer 38:14 entrance, a coming in, entering ; — ׳מ absolute 38:14 3 t. + Ezek 42:9 Kt (Qr מֵבִיא wrong, compare Co); construct מְבוֺא Deut 11:30 12 t.; suffix מְבוֺאוֺ Psa 104:19 2 t.; מְבֹאוֺ 50:1 ; מבואך 2Sam 3:25 Kt (Qr מוֺבָאֶ֑ךָ inexplicable compare Dr); plural construct מְבוֺאֵי Ezek 26:10 , מְבוֺאֹת 27:3 ; — 1 entrance , i.e. place or way of entrance, into a city Judg 1:24-25 , 1Chr 4:39 ; Prov 8:3 ( ׳מ מְּתָחִים ); into buildings 2Kin 11:16 ; 16:18 ; 1Chr 9:19 ( הַמָּבוֺא שֹׁמְרֵי ), 2Chr 23:13 , 15 ; Jer 38:14 ; Ezek 42:9 ; 46:19 ; see also יָם מְבוֺאֹת entrance of (the) sea, gate of the sea , of situation of Tyre 27:3 . 2 entering , act of entrance, by violence, in storm of city Ezek 26:10 ; coming in or together, making a crowd, עָ֑ם כִּמְבוֺא 33:31 simile of eagerness to hear Yahweh's word; in phrase וְאֶתמֿבואך אֶתמֿוֺצָאֲךָ 2Sam 3:25 thy going out and thy coming in, mode of entering temple , or the people who enter Ezek 44:5 ; particularly of sunset הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מְבוֺא Psa 104:19 ; = west Deut 11:30 ; Josh 1:4 ; 23:4 הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מְבוֺא הַגָּדוֺל הַיָּם = Mediterranean, Zech 8:7 הַשֶּׁמֶשׁ מְבוֺא אֶרֶץ (|| מִזְרָח אֶרֶץ ), Mal 1:11 ; Psa 50:1 ; 113:3 sunset = west , opposed to sunrise = east; in phrase from east to west , i.e. over the whole earth, everywhere on earth.
